connection_intro: Enable remote control on the display first: Settings > Network & Internet > Remote device settings > Control remotely, then set an authentication method under Home network > IP control > Authentication.
transports_intro: The REST API provides the full command surface. Simple IP Control adds the only push-notification path, so changes made at the display appear immediately instead of at the next poll. IRCC-IP emulates the physical remote for menu and on-screen-display navigation.
wol_intro: A suspended display shuts down its HTTP server, so neither REST nor IRCC can reach it. A Wake-on-LAN magic packet is the only way to bring it back. Enable Wake-on-LAN on the display under Remote device settings.
